name: quarterly_review
title: Quarterly / business review
description: Periodic performance review (QBR, monthly or annual business review): results against plan and prior periods, drivers, risks, next steps.
storyline: Answer first: the exec summary states the 3-5 takeaways; each later section proves one. Every chart compares against plan or the prior period and names its source and period.

slots.title: <Team or company> <period> review
slots.guidance: Title, subtitle with the period, presenter and date.

slots.title: <The period's headline result as a sentence>
slots.guidance: 3-5 takeaways, one per later section, each with its number and change ('Revenue $12.4M, +12% vs Q2').

slots.title: <What the headline metrics say>
slots.guidance: 1-4 headline metrics with the change vs the prior period; source and period on the slide.

slots.title: <How the key metric moved over the periods>
slots.guidance: One metric over 4-8 periods (line for many periods, columns for few); the title states the change; highlight the series that carries the message.

slots.title: <Which segment drove the change>
slots.guidance: The metric by region/product/segment, bars sorted largest first.

slots.title: <Where results beat or missed plan>
slots.guidance: Plan vs actual vs variance per line item; at most ~7 rows x 5 columns; numbers right-aligned.

slots.title: <The risks that could change the outlook>
slots.guidance: Left: risks with likelihood/impact; right: mitigation and owner.

slots.title: <What we expect next period and why>
slots.guidance: Forecast or targets for the next period, with the assumption behind each.

slots.title: Next steps: who does what by when
slots.guidance: Columns Action | Owner | Due. One row per commitment; a named owner and a date on every row.

slots.title: Appendix
slots.guidance: Section divider before the backup slides.

slots.title: <Supporting detail>
slots.guidance: Full tables the main slides summarised.
